exposure: Timing of data collection (during pregnancy vs. at delivery)
Timing of recruitment (during pregnancy vs. at delivery)
cohort: 9773 pregnant women recruited across Jamaica between July and September 2011
finding: The study found that while some clinical indicators showed good to moderate reporting consistency between pregnancy and delivery, most showed only fair agreement, and infectious conditions had poor reliability, highlighting the need for caution when interpreting self-reported pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was reported with good consistency between pregnancy and delivery (κ = 0.681).
